info.title: eGain Connector
info.description: This connector enables Copilot to securely call the eGain V3 API, providing seamless integration for customer engagement data. It supports authentication, data retrieval, and action execution, simplifying workflows and enhancing real-time insights across eGain services.

get.summary: Get the best search results for a user query
get.description: Get the best search results for a user query. It is not applicable for release 21.x.x.x

parameters.name: portalId
parameters.description: The portal ID for the eGain knowledge management portal

parameters.name: languageCode
parameters.description: Locale code for the search results (e.g., 'en-us', 'es-es', 'fr-fr')

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query or question to find relevant answers

parameters.name: personalizationProfileId
parameters.description: Optional personalization profile ID for customized results

parameters.name: authToken
parameters.description: Authentication token for eGain API access

parameters.name: baseUrl
parameters.description: Base URL for the eGain knowledge management portal

parameters.name: shortName
parameters.description: Short name identifier for the knowledge management portal

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Content type accepted by the API

get.summary: Service retrieves answers for a given scope, defined by data sources, eGain KB Portal, language, and personalisation profile id.
get.description: The service will retrieve a set of answers for a given scope. A scope is a collection of data sources or an eGain KB Portal with a specific language and personalization profile id.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Question or search term for generative AI responses

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: Optional department ID for department-specific results

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Optional user ID for personalized results

parameters.name: portalId
parameters.description: The portal ID for the eGain knowledge management portal
